Q subscript six: for every x, the object language product of x and the constant zero equals that constant zero. Q subscript seven: for all x and y, the object language product of x and the successor of y equals the sum of the object language product of x and y, and x. Q subscript eight: for all x and y, x is less than y if and only if there exists z such that the sum of the successor of z and x equals y. End of the eight axioms.
